description: This file defines a protocol and a class implementing remote services related to recording the screen and obtaining location information on macOS. It includes asynchronous functions for screen recording with audio, location authorization status, location accuracy, and current location retrieval.

classes.name: LiveMacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices
classes.description: A class implementing the MacNodeRuntimeMainActorServices protocol, providing functionalities for screen recording and location services on macOS.

methods.name: recordScreen
methods.description: Asynchronously records the screen with specified parameters and returns the file path and audio status.

methods.name: locationAuthorizationStatus
methods.description: Returns the current authorization status for location services.

methods.name: locationAccuracyAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the accuracy authorization level for location services.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current location with specified accuracy and timeout parameters.
